name: Angels Helping Us
overview: Scripture reveals that angels actively assist and protect believers as a demonstration of God's care. The psalmist affirms that the angel of the LORD surrounds and delivers those who fear Him (Psalms 34:7), and God commands His angels to watch over His people in all their ways (Psalms 91:11). Jesus' own experience shows angels ministering to Him after temptation (Matthew 4:11) and providing strength in times of trial (Luke 22:43). Additionally, the Lord highlights that even the angels in heaven attentively watch over His children (Matthew 18:10), underscoring their ongoing role in God's providential care for His people.
